summary: Verified WCAG contrast palette rollout on static export. DARK MODE primary teal buttons now render dark-ink (#0B1220 / rgb(11,18,32)) on teal (#14B8A6 / rgb(20,184,166)) globally including both Generate Course buttons on /ai-learning-hub. LIGHT MODE primary teal buttons remain white on dark teal (#FFFFFF on #0F766E) as intended. LIGHT MODE muted text tokens updated correctly: textMuted #5D6C82 (rgb 93,108,130) and textDim #7B8BA1 (rgb 123,139,161) — no lingering rgb(100,116,139) or rgb(148,163,184) samples in light mode. Regression sweep: Weekly Achievement Loop badge label (testid ai-learning-hub-weekly-streak-badge-label) still present and amber (#B45309 in light). Smoke: landing, login, /notifications, /my-analytics all render with correct body backgrounds and content. No new console errors beyond pre-existing 429 rate limits on unrelated bootstrap endpoints.

issues: login-submit-button 'SIGN IN' uses text color rgb(15,23,42) (dark navy) on teal bg rgb(15,118,110) — inconsistent with other light-mode primary CTAs which use rgb(255,255,255). Contrast is fine (readable dark on teal), but it deviates from the documented light-mode primary spec (white text). Non-blocking — flagged for consistency review only. Not part of this iteration's fix scope.

light_mode_muted_text_new_palette.legacy_100_116_139_or_148_163_184_in_lig: NOT DETECTED anywhere in light-mode DOM sampling — old palette fully replaced

action_items: OPTIONAL/non-blocking: consider aligning /auth/login SIGN IN button (testid login-submit-button) to use the tokenized primary-button text so it matches other light-mode primary CTAs (white on #0F766E) instead of hardcoded dark navy rgb(15,23,42). Contrast is still acceptable; flag only for token consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: The theme-token-validity CI gate with WCAG contract is a strong quality lock — verified in the browser that the runtime CSS matches the documented spec exactly (0B1220 on 14B8A6 dark, 5D6C82 muted light, 7B8BA1 dim light).

Some components still hardcode #FFFFFF or dark hex values on buttons instead of going through the token layer (e.g. login-submit-button uses non-tokenized dark text in light mode). Per agent note this is acceptable if button is not on teal-primary in dark mode, but hardcoded colors long-term erode the palette guarantee.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Static export (dist mode) at https://admin-policy-hub.preview.emergentagent.com. Login flow: navigate to /welcome then click 'Sign In' header link -> /auth/login. Rate-limit noise on /api/features/* and /api/auth/me during bootstrap is pre-existing (429s), unrelated to this iteration's changes. Theme toggles at bottom of left sidebar rail: theme-toggle-light / theme-toggle-system / theme-toggle-dark (welcome-* prefixed variants exist on public landing). Generate Course button has TWO testids on /ai-learning-hub discover tab: ai-learning-hub-quick-generate-course (in Quick actions row) and ai-learning-hub-generate-course-btn — both verified using new dark-ink-on-teal in dark mode.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration is a verification pass. Previous white-on-teal (rgb(255,255,255) on #14B8A6, 2.49:1) was fixed by changing V2_DARK primaryText token to #0B1220 in /app/frontend/src/theme/v2.ts and syncing FOUC vars in /app/frontend/app/+html.tsx. Runtime verification confirms all 8 sampled primary teal buttons in dark mode (including two Generate Course buttons and 6 landing CTAs) now use rgb(11,18,32) text on rgb(20,184,166) bg — WCAG 7.52:1 pass.
